name: pr-deck
description: Pane listing your open PRs across code hosts, grouped into stacks, with next-action buttons and a state file other tools can watch

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the PR pane when a session starts, without taking focus from the prompt.

startCollapsed.title: Start collapsed
startCollapsed.description: Cards start collapsed to their title line.

alwaysShowAll.title: Always show all projects
alwaysShowAll.description: Start with PRs from every repo instead of just the current one.

cardColors.title: Card colors
cardColors.description: attention dims the cards that are not waiting on you, status colours by PR state, repo gives one colour per repo and random one per PR.

pinYourMove.title: Pin "Your move" on top
pinYourMove.description: List the PRs waiting on you in a group above the repos.

buttonStyle.title: Button labels
buttonStyle.description: Show icons, text or both on the card buttons.

defaultGroup.title: Default grouping
defaultGroup.description: How PRs inside a repo are grouped when the pane opens.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane fetches PRs.

showSummary.title: Show summary
showSummary.description: Show a one-line summary from the PR body under each title.

summaryLength.title: Summary length
summaryLength.description: Longest summary shown before it is cut with an ellipsis.

showFableButton.title: Show Fable review button
showFableButton.description: Show the button that asks the session to review the PR with a subagent and report back.

showCopilotPass.title: Offer Copilot pass
showCopilotPass.description: On GitHub, offer a Copilot review once a PR is green and only waiting on people.

providers.title: Code hosts
providers.description: Comma-separated hosts to fetch PRs from: github, gitlab, gitea, azdo.

tracker.title: Issue tracker
tracker.description: Where ticket keys in PR titles and branches link to.

trackerUrl.title: Issue tracker URL
trackerUrl.description: Base URL the ticket key is appended to, like https://yourcompany.atlassian.net/browse/ or https://linear.app/yourteam/issue/; empty shows the key as plain text.

githubCommand.title: GitHub fetch command
githubCommand.description: Shell command that prints the GitHub GraphQL response; empty uses gh api graphql, {query} is the query.

gitlabCommand.title: GitLab fetch command
gitlabCommand.description: Shell command that prints the GitLab GraphQL response; empty uses glab api graphql, {query} is the query.

giteaCommand.title: Gitea/Forgejo fetch command
giteaCommand.description: Shell command that prints the Gitea JSON response; empty uses tea api.

azdoCommand.title: Azure DevOps fetch command
azdoCommand.description: Shell command that prints the Azure DevOps PR list JSON; empty uses az repos pr list.

openCommand.title: Open URL command
openCommand.description: Opens links in the browser; {url} is the link.

editorCommand.title: Open config file command
editorCommand.description: Opens the config file; {path} is its path. A terminal editor like vim, or a command that fails, falls back to the system opener.

remoteCommand.title: Current repo command
remoteCommand.description: Prints the remote URL of the session's repo, used to scope the pane.

cloneDir.title: Local clone folder
cloneDir.description: Where your repos are cloned, like ~/code/{host}/{owner}/{repo}; empty starts new sessions in the current folder.

newSessionCommand.title: New session command
newSessionCommand.description: Opens a new Claude session for a PR, with {claude}, {dir}, {prompt}, {shellPrompt}, {label}, {url}, {branch}, {repo} and {name}; empty opens a tab or window in the terminal you are using.

autoRename.title: Auto rename sessions
autoRename.description: Name the sessions that New session opens or Switch here moves.

sessionName.title: Session name
sessionName.description: Name for the session that New session opens or Switch here moves; empty uses the default, turn Auto rename sessions off to skip naming. Placeholders: {pr} (or {number}), {url}, {title}, {branch}, {base}, {repo}, {fullName}, {host}, {cli}.

fablePrompt.title: Fable review prompt
fablePrompt.description: Prompt the Fable review button sends; empty uses the default. Placeholders: {pr} (or {number}), {url}, {title}, {branch}, {base}, {repo}, {fullName}, {host}, {cli}.
fablePrompt.default: Spawn a subagent with model fable to review {url} against the repo's own standards. Report findings to me, do not post anything to {host}.

workPrompt.title: Work on it prompt
workPrompt.description: Prompt the Work on it button sends and the first prompt of New session; empty uses the default. Placeholders: {pr} (or {number}), {url}, {title}, {branch}, {base}, {repo}, {fullName}, {host}, {cli}.
workPrompt.default: Load context for {url}: check out branch {branch} in the {repo} repo, read the PR description, diff, CI status and review comments ({cli} reads them), then wait for my instructions.

watchPrompt.title: Watch prompt
watchPrompt.description: Prompt the Watch button sends; empty uses the default. Placeholders: {pr} (or {number}), {url}, {title}, {branch}, {base}, {repo}, {fullName}, {host}, {cli}.
watchPrompt.default: Watch {url} until it is green: re-check its CI and review state with {cli} every few minutes, waiting in the background between checks, tell me about each change in one line, and stop as soon as CI passes and nothing else needs me.

stateFile.title: State file
stateFile.description: JSON file rewritten on every refresh with every PR picked up, grouped by repo, for other tools to watch; off turns it off, empty uses the default.
